summary: IDEAYA Biosciences filed an 8-K (Items 7.01 and 8.01) furnishing an ASCO 2026 investor presentation and disclosing positive Phase 2/3 data from the OptimUM-02 trial of darovasertib+crizotinib in first-line HLA*A2:01 negative metastatic uveal melanoma. The trial met its primary endpoint with median PFS of 6.9 vs 3.1 months (HR 0.42). This is a routine clinical trial data update, not a special situation. No corporate transaction, activist campaign, or strategic review is involved.
